rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is amazed or greatly surprised.

example.english: I was so amazed that I couldn't speak.
example.traditional: 我真係驚訝到講唔出嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 ging1 ngaa6 dou3 gong2 m4 ceot1 je5

rows.note: Use this when the amazement mainly comes from something being unexpected.

example.english: I was amazed that they won the championship; it was completely unexpected.
example.traditional: 我估唔到佢會攞冠軍，真係好意外。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 wui5 lo2 gun1 gwan1 zan1 hai6 hou2 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this for a stronger, more shocking kind of amazement.

example.english: We were all amazed and shocked when we heard this news.
example.traditional: 聽到呢單新聞，我哋全部都震驚。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou2 ni1 daan1 san1 man4 ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 zan3 ging1
